title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Augustana University
description: Verifiable late-night dining and ritual spots for Augustana University students in Sioux Falls, featuring campus traditions and local 24-hour staples.

cards.title: Moonlight Breakfast at Ordal
cards.subtitle: A finals week tradition in Morrison Commons
cards.notes: Attend the Semester Shutdown to enjoy free late-night breakfast served by faculty. This tradition includes bingo and trivia to help students de-stress before exams.
cards.short_summary: Ordal Dining Hall hosts the 'Moonlight Breakfast' during finals week, a signature campus event where faculty serve students late-night meals.
cards.evidence_claim: Augustana University's Semester Shutdown includes Moonlight Breakfast from 9-10:30 p.m. followed by bingo in the Ordal Dining Hall.
cards.access_notes: Open late specifically during Semester Shutdown events; typically 9:00 PM to 10:30 PM.

cards.title: 24-Hour Tacos on Minnesota Ave
cards.subtitle: Authentic Mexican food near campus
cards.notes: Visit this 24-hour staple for street tacos and burritos. It is a frequent destination for students seeking authentic late-night meals just a short drive from the dorms.
cards.short_summary: Giliberto's is a local 24-hour Mexican restaurant known for its extensive menu of tacos, burritos, and breakfast plates available at any hour.
cards.evidence_claim: Giliberto's Mexican Taco Shop at 712 S Minnesota Ave is open 24 hours a day and serves breakfast all day.
cards.source_title: Giliberto's Mexican Taco Shop - Experience Sioux Falls

cards.title: The 24/7 Fryn' Pan Run
cards.subtitle: Classic diner food on W 41st St
cards.notes: Stop by for a late-night skillet or pie. This 24-hour diner is a reliable spot for study groups needing a change of scenery and a full kitchen menu after midnight.
cards.short_summary: Fryn' Pan is a regional 24-hour diner chain offering classic American comfort food, breakfast, and a soup and salad bar.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fryn' Pan Family Restaurant in Sioux Falls offers 24-hour dining and free wireless internet.
cards.source_title: Fryn' Pan Family Restaurant - Sioux Falls

cards.title: Evening Brews at Viking Grounds
cards.subtitle: Starbucks coffee in the Siverson Lounge
cards.notes: Grab a latte or pastry while studying in the Morrison Commons. This on-campus spot serves Starbucks products and provides a social atmosphere for evening work.
cards.short_summary: Viking Grounds is the primary on-campus coffee shop, located in the Morrison Commons and serving Starbucks coffee and pastries.
cards.evidence_claim: Viking Grounds in the Morrison Commons has regular hours until 7:00 PM on weekdays and weekends.
cards.source_title: Hours of Operation - Augustana University Dining
cards.access_notes: Open until 7:00 PM daily during the regular semester.

cards.title: Late Snacks at the C-Store
cards.subtitle: On-campus convenience in Morrison Commons
cards.notes: Pick up grab-and-go snacks, beverages, or basic groceries using your Viking Bucks. It is the most convenient late-evening option for residents in the central campus area.
cards.short_summary: The Market Cstore is Augustana's on-campus convenience store, providing snacks and essentials for students until mid-evening.
cards.evidence_claim: The Market Cstore is open until 8:00 PM daily during the regular academic semester.
cards.access_notes: Open until 8:00 PM daily during the regular semester.

cards.title: Pancheros Burrito Runs
cards.subtitle: Fresh-pressed tortillas on 41st St
cards.notes: Head to 41st Street for a burrito with fresh-pressed tortillas. It is a popular off-campus choice for students looking for a quick, substantial meal until 11 PM.
cards.short_summary: Pancheros Mexican Grill is a fast-casual restaurant known for its custom burritos and fresh-pressed tortillas, open late into the evening.
cards.evidence_claim: Pancheros Mexican Grill at 1503 W 41st St is open until 11:00 PM daily.

cards.title: Grocery Runs at Hy-Vee
cards.subtitle: Late-night essentials on Minnesota Ave
cards.notes: Visit the South Minnesota location for late-night grocery needs or a quick meal from the food court. It serves as a primary resource for off-campus and apartment residents.
cards.short_summary: Hy-Vee is a regional grocery chain with a location near campus that offers a wide selection of food and a pharmacy until 11 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sioux Falls #3 Hy-Vee at 3000 South Minnesota Avenue is open daily from 6 a.m. to 11 p.m.

cards.title: Casey's Pizza Night
cards.subtitle: Convenience and pizza on N Minnesota Ave
cards.notes: Order a signature pizza or grab quick snacks at this convenience store. It is a well-known regional spot for late-night food runs when other kitchens are closed.
cards.short_summary: Casey's is a convenience store chain famous for its pizza, offering delivery and pickup options until late evening.
cards.evidence_claim: The Casey's at 1400 N Minnesota Ave is open until 11:00 PM daily, with kitchen services available for pickup and delivery.
cards.source_title: 1400 N Minnesota Ave - Pizza Delivery and Pickup in Sioux Falls, SD | Casey's

cards.title: Late Nights at Mikkelsen
cards.subtitle: The primary late-night study hub
cards.notes: Utilize the library's extended hours during finals week for deep study sessions. It offers a quiet environment and access to resources long after academic buildings close.
cards.short_summary: Mikkelsen Library is the main academic library at Augustana, offering extended hours and dedicated study spaces during the semester.
cards.evidence_claim: Mikkelsen Library provides extended hours during the spring semester finals period, as noted on their official social media and campus updates.
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by term; extended late-night hours are provided during finals week.

cards.title: Toppers Late-Night Delivery
cards.subtitle: Pizza and Topperstix until 3 AM
cards.notes: Order Topperstix for a late-night study group. This chain is a favorite for its 3 AM closing time and reliable delivery to campus dormitories.
cards.short_summary: Toppers Pizza is a delivery-focused chain known for its late-night availability and signature 'Topperstix' cheesy breadsticks.
cards.evidence_claim: Toppers Pizza in Sioux Falls is documented by student media as serving food until 3 a.m., making it a staple for late-night runs.
cards.access_notes: Open for delivery and pickup until 3:00 AM daily.
